segmentation.text: Upon approaching an authorized emergency vehicle or an official vehicle of a regulatory agency which is moving or preparing to move in any direction,
including, without limitation, arriving at or leaving the scene of a crash or other incident,
and making use of flashing lights meeting the requirements of
subsection 3 of NRS 484A.480 [DEF-NRS-484A-480-3],
the driver of any other vehicle shall,
except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer:
If the authorized emergency vehicle or official vehicle of a regulatory agency:
(1) Approaches the driver’s vehicle,
proceed
as required pursuant to subsection 1 [NRS-484B-267-1a, NRS-484B-267-1b, NRS-484B-267-1c];
or (2) Stops,
proceed
as required pursuant to NRS 484B.607 [NRS-484B-607-1a, NRS-484B-607-1b, NRS-484B-607-1c, NRS-484B-607-1d].

As used in this section, “preparing to move” means any indication that is visible to an approaching driver that an authorized emergency vehicle or an official vehicle of a regulatory agency is about to move, including, without limitation: (a) A movement of the vehicle; or (b) The use of hand signals by the driver of the vehicle.

elements.justification: 'an authorized emergency vehicle' is DEF-NRS-484A-020::authorized_emergency_vehicle ('a vehicle permitted to depart from certain traffic laws when equipped and operated in the manner provided by law'); its 'not a stand-in for' a responding role does not bite, the conduct being read separately. 'an official vehicle of a regulatory agency' is ru.official_vehicle of kind regulatory_agency. 'Upon approaching': the subject, moving (kin.speed above the halt tolerance), has the vehicle ahead (rel.bearing longitudinal component positive) within the approach reach (rel.centre_distance; no clearance read). 'which is moving': kin.speed above the halt tolerance; 'or preparing to move' (s12): visible from the subject (rel.visible) with an arm signal (sig.hand_signal) or a lit turn indicator (sig.turn_indicator: the signal, not the manoeuvre). 'in any direction' adds no restriction.

sig.warning_lamp 'a warning lamp lit; colour ..., mode ..., facing ...'; the words borrowed from DEF-NRS-484A-480-3, 'at least one flashing red warning lamp visible from the front', fix a lamp lit red, flashing, facing front. Not a stand-in for an audible warning: no siren is read.

'any other vehicle' is DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle ('every device in, upon or by which any person or property is or may be transported or drawn upon a highway'); 'other' excludes the approached vehicle; 'the driver' is read through the vehicle's controlled motion.
dev.human_direction role police_officer ('a person directing traffic and the direction given'), governing (dev.governs) a travel region (st.travel_region) the subject occupies (rel.occupies).

'Approaches the driver’s vehicle': the approached vehicle, moving (kin.speed above the halt tolerance), has the subject's vehicle ahead of it (rel.bearing from that vehicle to the subject, 'direction of b from a in a's frame', longitudinal component positive) within the approach reach of centre distance (rel.centre_distance; not a clearance). 'the driver’s vehicle' is the subject.

'proceed' is the subject's continued driving while the vehicle approaches it: its motion (kin.speed, 'magnitude of velocity'), which the rules of subsection 1 composed on s9r judge; the duty is the compliance those rules state, read at every observation at which the condition holds, the subject moving or not.

The section's definition of 'preparing to move', read as s1 reads it: visible from the subject (rel.visible); '(a) A movement of the vehicle' kin.speed above the halt tolerance; '(b) The use of hand signals' sig.hand_signal other than no_signal; 'including, without limitation' admits a lit turn indicator (sig.turn_indicator).

compositions.quote: at least one flashing red warning lamp visible from the front

residues.why: 'including, without limitation' lists examples of a vehicle moving or preparing to move; the duty is the same whether or not the vehicle is arriving at or leaving the scene of a crash or other incident

applicability: The subject is a member of DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle, moving (kin.speed above p.halt_speed_tolerance). Some road user e, not the subject, a member of DEF-NRS-484A-020::authorized_emergency_vehicle or an ru.official_vehicle of kind regulatory_agency, shows a lit sig.warning_lamp red, flashing, facing front; e is moving (kin.speed above p.halt_speed_tolerance) or preparing to move (rel.visible from the subject and e's sig.hand_signal other than no_signal or sig.turn_indicator other than off); e lies ahead of the subject (rel.bearing from the subject, longitudinal component positive) within p.emergency_approach_reach (rel.centre_distance); and e approaches the subject's vehicle: e moving (kin.speed above p.halt_speed_tolerance) with the subject ahead of e (rel.bearing from e, longitudinal component positive) within p.emergency_approach_reach. Not applicable where a dev.human_direction of role police_officer governs (dev.governs) a st.travel_region the subject occupies (rel.occupies).
obligation: The subject proceeds as subsection 1 requires: it complies with NRS_484B_267_1a, NRS_484B_267_1b_o1, NRS_484B_267_1b_o2 and NRS_484B_267_1c, each composed with its binder subject mapped to this node's subject (a composed rule not engaged counts as complied with).

narrowings.why: 'the driver' of a vehicle is read through the vehicle's controlled motion
'preparing to move', defined as an indication that the vehicle is 'about to move', is read through the visible indications the definition lists and a lit turn indicator
'visible to an approaching driver' is read as the vehicle being in the subject's line of sight (rel.visible)

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: An ambulance with its red front lamp flashing moves toward the subject head-on within the reach while the subject moves toward it; the subject keeps its lane and speed, neither yielding nor moving to the right-hand edge nor stopping, so a composed rule of subsection 1 is violated.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: Same approach; the subject moves to a position parallel to and close to the right-hand edge, clear of the intersection, and stops there until the ambulance has passed, complying with every composed rule.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: The subject drives; no emergency or regulatory-agency vehicle is in the scene. The duty binds the subject alone.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: As in forbid, but the source does not observe warning lamps.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: The subject follows the ambulance, lamps flashing, which moves away ahead of it in the same direction: the subject approaches it but the ambulance does not approach the subject's vehicle.

param_proposals.name: p.emergency_approach_reach
param_proposals.convention: centre distance within which a driver approaching an emergency or enforcement vehicle that shows flashing warning lamps counts as approaching it: about the distance at which the lamps are conspicuous by day and a driver at an urban speed of 15 m/s has ten seconds to slow
param_proposals.source: warning-lamp conspicuity and perception-reaction figures (as proposed this iteration by NRS_484B_267_2a)

param_proposals.name: p.halt_speed_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution
param_proposals.source: source speed resolution (as proposed this iteration by LVMC_11_12_070_B)

contract: The road user is at rest at the observation — "complete cessation from movement" — observed as its speed (kin.speed) at or below a tolerance the caller sets for the source's speed resolution. It denotes a state at one observation: it says nothing of how long the road user stays at rest, where it is, or why. Not denoted: a slowing whose sampled speed stays above the tolerance.

params.name: speed_tol
params.meaning: the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution

elements.span: observed as its speed (kin.speed) at or below a tolerance
elements.justification: kin.speed is the 'magnitude of velocity'; "complete cessation from movement" is a magnitude of velocity of zero, observed on sampled speeds within the tolerance speed_tol. Not a stand-in for a brake lamp or a deceleration, neither of which is read.

scenarios.name: holds
scenarios.narrative: The road user's speed is zero at the observation.

scenarios.name: fails
scenarios.narrative: The road user slows but its sampled speed stays above the tolerance at the observation.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: The source does not observe speed.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: Same scene; the subject slows and moves to a lane not adjacent to the halted police car as it passes.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: The subject drives; no emergency or regulatory-agency vehicle is in the scene. The duty binds the subject alone.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: As in forbid, but the source does not observe warning lamps.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: The police car, lamp flashing, keeps moving ahead of the subject and never stops.
